summary: Running a module's main function in tests is hard because arguments arrive on STDIN and exit_json/fail_json don't behave well in tests.
questions: Why is it hard to call a module's main() in a unit test?

answer_card.title: Problems running main() in tests
answer_card.answer_md:
Two issues:
- Modules read arguments from `STDIN`, which is awkward to set up in a test.
- Modules end with `exit_json` or `fail_json`, which don't work properly in a test environment.
